summary: American Airlines filed a 424B5 preliminary prospectus supplement offering $235,765,000 in Class B Pass Through Certificates (Series 2026-1B). The proceeds will initially be held in escrow, then used to acquire equipment notes secured by 32 aircraft (eleven Boeing 737 MAX 8, six A321 XLR, twelve A321-200, and three Boeing 777-300ER). Distributions are subordinated to Class A certificates. The filing is a routine debt/asset-backed securities offering, not a special situation. No premium, board recommendation, or special-situation dynamics. Watch for required liquidity facility from Natixis; no risk-arb angle.
